Data reaching api answer: Names, email, title, status, scope, Telegram username/account ID, assistant owner/program/eventsUrl/skillsUrl
Classification and conditions: Personal data. Assistant URLs may contain user-provided query credentials; no issued assistant key in PersonView.

Data reaching api answer: PersonView and inviteUrl containing a newly issued bearer token
Classification and conditions: Credential issuance available to owner API.

Data reaching api answer: Invite recipient/company metadata, accepted person/session
Classification and conditions: Requires a valid invite token; not a way to enumerate token values. Session cookie is not copied by api send().

Data reaching api answer: Company structure, people, employee instructions/skills and changes, subscription and integration metadata
Classification and conditions: Personal/internal data under existing owner views and masking.

Data reaching api answer: Plan owner, account emails, machines, labels, usage, budgets, API endpoint, last4
Classification and conditions: Personal data and credential metadata. secret_enc is not selected by SubView; endpoint query parameters can carry user-supplied credentials.

Data reaching api answer: Per-plan/per-model usage
Classification and conditions: Internal usage and ownership data.

Data reaching api answer: Node IDs, hostnames, public keys, credential version or stored count
Classification and conditions: Public keys/metadata, not decrypted saved plan sign-in.

Data reaching api answer: Machine identities, hostnames, owner and access state
Classification and conditions: Machine/person metadata. No browser signing private key returned.

Data reaching api answer: Active decrypted install command with one-use --join code
Classification and conditions: Bearer credential reaches the model through generic api, even though dedicated machine_command reports only SHOWN_TO_CEO. Existing test intentionally permits this.

Data reaching api answer: shown notice for orchestrator-created commands, subscription metadata
Classification and conditions: No code in the immediate orchestrator answer; it can be read through GET /api/nodes/commands.

Data reaching api answer: Fresh machine/node credentials, nodes[].key
Classification and conditions: Conditional on possessing a valid join code. Not unlocked merely by owner headers.

Data reaching api answer: publicKey, wrapped private key, salt, iv, iterations
Classification and conditions: Encrypted key material; server does not unwrap it. PUT additionally verifies the person password.

Data reaching api answer: New recovery file: age private identity; public recipient/certificate; link.key and tunnel settings when a public link exists
Classification and conditions: Credential issuance available to owner API when lead mode and authority exist. Raw recovery material enters the api answer. No production call made.

Data reaching api answer: Backup metadata, holder machine names, recovery creator/time and restore state
Classification and conditions: Personal/internal metadata. GET does not return an existing private recovery identity.

Data reaching api answer: Service-account/share email, integration metadata, last4
Classification and conditions: No saved Google private key in googleSheetsView. PUT accepts credentials supplied by caller.

Data reaching api answer: GitHub owner, tokenLast4 and repository metadata
Classification and conditions: No decrypted saved GitHub token in hostView.

Data reaching api answer: Bot username
Classification and conditions: No saved Telegram bot token in response; token supplied by caller. People Telegram identities appear in PersonView.

Data reaching api answer: Rules, repository URL/branch, author and test settings
Classification and conditions: Internal text and user-supplied URLs may contain private data. Stored repo token is not returned.

Data reaching api answer: Notebook text and attribution
Classification and conditions: Arbitrary private/internal text.

Data reaching api answer: Task body, logs, request text/options/answers, files and authors
Classification and conditions: Arbitrary private content under owner access. Structured fields are not a guarantee that free text contains no secrets.

Data reaching api answer: Question/decision contents and answer state
Classification and conditions: Private content; marker distinguishes orchestrator after this task fix.

Data reaching api answer: Task/work metadata and backlog text
Classification and conditions: Internal data; backlog text is arbitrary.

Data reaching api answer: Masked conversation events, messages and tool/result text
Classification and conditions: Existing viewer masking still applies; owner sees content allowed by viewerOf/maskEvent. Not a claim all stored events are raw.

Data reaching api answer: Job result, tail, error, machine and times
Classification and conditions: Arbitrary program output may contain private text. Public job response excludes prompt, session and tool token.

Data reaching api answer: Authorized file or picture bytes
Classification and conditions: Private file contents under attachmentForPerson. Generic api treats the body as text and caps 30000 characters; this is not redaction.

Data reaching api answer: Phone identity/serial, owner, state and available-machine metadata
Classification and conditions: Personal/device metadata under phone route authorization.

Data reaching api answer: Live phone screen / recorded frame metadata and image bytes
Classification and conditions: May contain personal screen content; existing phone/recording checks apply. Binary body is not a useful structured image tool answer.

Data reaching api answer: Entry metadata/site/login and audit entries
Classification and conditions: No password or TOTP seed returned by vault HTTP routes. The separate vault_entry tool intentionally returns an authorized password/current code.

Data reaching api answer: Decrypted recipient address, contact/source/evidence/permission data
Classification and conditions: Third-party personal data; policy question already belongs to #1193.

Data reaching api answer: Message/review/setup history, contact and account metadata, catalog contents
Classification and conditions: Private/internal data, subject to outbound views. Saved transport secret is not an account response field. Agent job-token routes for submit/status are not opened by owner headers alone.

Data reaching api answer: Feedback/report text and inbound issue metadata
Classification and conditions: Arbitrary private report content. Inbound webhook route uses its own authorization.

Data reaching api answer: Merge conflict values and suggested improvement text
Classification and conditions: May carry copied/private record contents.

Data reaching api answer: Check metadata/measurements
Classification and conditions: Existing check view boundary; not unrestricted raw held-out dataset export.

Data reaching api answer: 403 assistant_not_allowed for orchestrator
Classification and conditions: Intentional exception pending policy decision. Head explicitly excluded removing guard from #1204. Direct person key issuance returns raw key/signingSecret, but api cannot reach that issuance.

Data reaching api answer: No automatic owner authorization
Classification and conditions: Separate keeper, node, assistant or running-job bearer credential required. api cannot provide arbitrary Authorization headers.

Data reaching api answer: Letter sender, task and private letter text, counts and inbox mode
Classification and conditions: Private communication under agentFor/lettersFor view authorization. Opening the route does not itself mark letters read.

Data reaching api answer: Wait/card/policy records, ownership and reasons
Classification and conditions: Internal task/decision data; free-text reasons may be private. Existing views and access checks apply.

Data reaching api answer: Node/plan identifiers, connection times, cause, close reason, errors and report
Classification and conditions: Machine history and arbitrary diagnostic text.

Data reaching api answer: Task/branch/commit metadata, role/staff and serving-subscription views
Classification and conditions: Internal work and personnel metadata.

Data reaching api answer: Pool status and recovery question/copy metadata
Classification and conditions: Internal machine/work metadata under route checks. Recovery question is not the private backup recovery file.

Method and route: GET /api/link; GET /api/link/names/:name; GET /api/map/layout; GET /api/updates; GET /api/updates/current; GET /api/setup; GET /api/setup/names/:name
Data reaching api answer: Public link/TLS metadata, map position, installed/update/setup status
Classification and conditions: Configuration/status responses; no saved relay signing key returned by linkOf. Error/status text can describe internal machine state.

Data reaching api answer: No ordinary JSON owner-api download response
Classification and conditions: Picture upload requires a person (me.via refused) and raw bytes; api body is JSON. Declared indefinite stream/terminal paths are refused by control.ts.
